description: v2.5 (CF-WO-P0-006 Addendum C; CF-WO-P0-007 Correction B). First-run character registration record. Character Name (display_name) + Unique Character ID (character_id) are REQUIRED; ID uniqueness is validated by the registration process (a second registration reusing an existing character_id is rejected — see the duplicate-ID check in tests/test_schemas.py), never silently merged. Registration is optional and skippable on first run; a registration is either temporary (registered-temporary) or permanent (registered-permanent) and is NEVER silently converted from temporary to permanent. Character data is private by default: media binaries stay in the private overlay; only relative pointers + hashes are stored here, and no private media is committed to the public repo. Structured 'ownership' (owner_id + workspace_id + visibility + sharing) is REQUIRED: explicit owner + workspace must exist, visibility is private by default, a character must NOT become public merely because an image was uploaded, and shared access requires an explicit future sharing permission. Voice profiles are linked by ID only, never embedded. Consent/permissions are required: a real person's likeness or voice must never be registered or used without explicit consent.

additional_reference_images.description: Extra reference images beyond the canonical set (expressions, outfits, angles). Each is an asset reference, not an embedded binary.

audio_assets.description: Voice/audio asset references for this character (reference recordings, samples). Pointers only; the audio itself lives in the private overlay and is workspace-scoped — never shared across characters or users.

canonical_reference_images.description: The canonical reference images that fix this character's identity (structure). At least one is required; front-facing is the reliable anchor for face-critical work.

character_id.description: Unique Character ID. Required; unique across the registry — a duplicate ID is rejected by the registration process.

consent_permissions.description: Consent and permissions for this character's likeness and voice. Required: a real person's likeness/voice must never be registered without explicit consent; the scope states what the consent covers.

display_name.description: Character Name. Required, with the unique character_id.

expression_pose_references.description: Reference images for expressions and poses (expression library / pose sheet entries). Asset references only.

features.description: Fixed identity features. Face is the anchor; clothing is scene-variable and listed here only as the character's default/identifying outfit, never as a lock.

fixed_prompt_block.description: The fixed identity prompt block for this character (CF-WO-P1-004-R1-ADDENDUM-IDENTITY, Task E): the short stable text block describing the fixed identity, injected into every generation. Machine-readable form of the character-consistency skill's prompt block; optional so every existing record remains valid.

generation_seed.description: The fixed generation seed for this character (CF-WO-P1-004-R1-ADDENDUM-IDENTITY, Task E): one seed recorded per character and used in every generation. Optional so every existing record remains valid.

ownership.description: Structured private ownership. owner_id + workspace_id are stable, opaque, randomly generated local identifiers — never a real name, email or account detail. visibility is private by default; sharing is none by default and requires an explicit future sharing permission.

ownership_scope.description: DEPRECATED — superseded by the structured 'ownership' object. Kept as an optional legacy string for migration only; new records must use 'ownership'. Never used as an identity on its own.

registration_history.description: History of registration events. temporary vs permanent is recorded here and never silently changed: registered-temporary stays temporary until an explicit permanent registration event.

species.description: Species, e.g. 'human' or 'African grey parrot'. Free text so fictional creatures are not forced into a human/animal box.

visual_style_profile.description: The visual-style profile this character is registered under (style + medium + motion methods). Inline summary; the full profile lives in visual-style-profile.json and is linked by ID where a record exists.
